tasks.title: 将类别号 CN005 改为 CN004
tasks.analysis: 直接修改被 GN0007 引用的父表主码，返回 ERROR 1451。外键采用默认 RESTRICT，不允许留下无效引用；类别号保持 CN005。若业务确需变更，可设计 ON UPDATE CASCADE，或在事务内新增父记录、迁移子表引用后删除旧父记录。

results.sql: UPDATE Category SET CategoryNO='CN004' WHERE CategoryNO='CN005';
results.stderr: ERROR 1451 (23000) at line 1: Cannot delete or update a parent row: a foreign key constraint fails (`supermarket_exp_2`.`goods`, CONSTRAINT `fk_goods_category` FOREIGN KEY (`CategoryNO`) REFERENCES `category` (`CategoryNO`))

results.sql: SELECT CategoryNO FROM Category WHERE CategoryNO IN ('CN004','CN005');

tasks.title: 将 2020 年销售总数量小于三的商品售价打八折
tasks.analysis: “销售数量”按该商品 2020 年合计销量理解，只包含该年确有销售记录的商品。GN0001 的年销量为 5，不打折；GN0005 为 1，按前题提升后的售价计算，结果为 16.63。

results.sql:
UPDATE Goods AS g
JOIN (SELECT GoodsNO FROM SaleBill
      WHERE HappenTime >= '2020-01-01' AND HappenTime < '2021-01-01'
      GROUP BY GoodsNO HAVING SUM(Number)<3) AS t
  ON t.GoodsNO=g.GoodsNO
SET g.SalePrice=ROUND(g.SalePrice*0.8,2);
SELECT ROW_COUNT() AS affected_rows;
SELECT GoodsNO,SalePrice FROM Goods ORDER BY GoodsNO;
results.stdout:
GoodsNO	SalePrice
GN0001	3.68
GN0002	6.09
GN0005	16.63
GN0007	157.50

tasks.title: 删除 2018 年以前生产的商品并处理外键引用
tasks.analysis: GN0002 尚有两条销售记录，直接删除返回 ERROR 1451。正确处理是先删除对应销售记录，再删除商品；两个动作放在同一事务中，商品与销售记录一起提交。

results.sql: DELETE FROM Goods WHERE ProductTime<'2018-01-01';
